text:
Mara (product): Heads-up — experimenting with a Saved Filters redesign for Console analytics. Proposal: let teams save filters at the route level, but also add an explicit per-model toggle so users can view "route + model" snapshots. Also need ownership and visibility rules (team vs org vs personal). Thoughts?

Devon (frontend): +1 to the per-model toggle. UX question: should the toggle live in the saved-query modal or as a persistent pill on the route page? I prefer the modal for discoverability.

Samir (metrics): If we add model-scoped saves we need to update telemetry to include model_id on saved-query usage events. Right now saved_query.view has no model context — that'll break our per-model cost rollups.

Jon P (platform): Architecture concern: saved-filter shape matters for routing policies. If a saved query includes a model preference, the route-level routing middleware needs to respect fallback policies (e.g., if model X is down use Y). We should not hard-bind saved queries to a single model in the routing layer.

Keiko (security): Also consider RBAC. org-level saved views should be readable by team members only, not every org user by default. We might reuse existing `view:routes` perms but need an explicit `savedquery:manage` scope.

Devon (frontend): Implementation thought — store saved filters like: 
```
{
  id, owner_id, route_id, name, scope: [personal|team|org], entries: [{model_id?, expr}]
}
```
That keeps entries flexible (model optional).

Samir (metrics): That schema works. We'll emit events: `savedquery.apply` with fields `route_id`, `model_id?`, `scope`. That'll let dashboards show per-model frequency and cost.

Mara (product): UX trade: if model toggle is optional, saved queries can still be reused across models — good for portability. But product needs an explicit checkbox "Lock to model" to avoid surprising cost differences.

Jon P (platform): Side note: quotas. If saved queries are tied to a model, quota calculation for reserved capacity vs hosted usage must attribute tokens correctly. We'll need to plumb `saved_query_id` through the API for billing.

Keiko (security): And audit logs. Any create/update/delete of org-scope saved queries should emit an audit event with `actor_id` and diff. We already log route config changes, add this to compliance list.

Devon (frontend): For rollout UX: feature-flag the per-model toggle behind `console.saved_queries.model_toggle`. Start with 10% orgs. For the modal: default to unlocked, with a tooltip: "Locking fixes the model for this view (affects cost/latency)."

ui-bot: Note — latest design mock `FILT-1123` uploaded to figma: https://figma.com/file/XXXX/FILT-1123

Mara (product): Action items: 1) Jon to scope API change to include `saved_query_id` and optional `model_id` in request headers for billing/routing (owner: Jon). 2) Samir to add telemetry events and mapping to cost dashboards (owner: Samir). 3) Keiko to draft RBAC + audit requirements. 4) Devon to prototype modal with checkbox and error state when locked model is unavailable. I'll write a short RFC.

Jon P (platform): I'll stub the header `X-Saved-Query: <id>` + `X-Saved-Query-Model: <model>` and validate in middleware. If model missing, middleware uses normal routing rules.

deploy-bot: prod deploy started: infra/api:v2026.03.15-5 — will patch middleware when ready.

Mara (product): Thanks all. I'll post the RFC link when done. If anyone wants to join a quick design sync tomorrow, ping me. :thumbsup:
